title: A linear bound for a connectivity partition in graphs
summary: Kühn and Osthus proved that, for every positive integer $\ell$, every $2^{16}\ell^2$-connected graph $G$ has a partition $V(G)=S\cup T$ such that $G[S]$ and $G[T]$ are $\ell$-connected and $d_T(v)\geq \ell$ for every $v\in S$. And they asked whether the quadratic bound can be replaced by a linear bound. In this paper, we answer this question in the affirmative by proving that every $641\ell$-connected graph $G$ has a partition $V(G)=S\cup T$ such that $G[S]$ and $G[T]$ are $\ell$-connected and $d_T(v)\ge \ell$ for every $v\in S$. The proof integrates the Moser-Tardos resampling algorithm.
